package other

func Get(n string) (int, error) {
	// Get returns the thing named n.
	// It returns an error if n is unknown.
	//
	// The prose above is one golden question's, verbatim, and it is inside a
	// function body on purpose: StripDocs blanks doc comments and keeps every
	// comment inside a body, so this span carries it in both corpora. That is
	// what makes a missing repo_id filter change the answer rather than add a
	// row nobody looks at.

}
